plan.scope: Twenty-one-case discovery of two independent packed cost/ordinal accumulators over eight candidates, with one admitted four-element tail when required. The paired word/index minimum preserves earliest original source order. Each candidate uses the matching one-accumulator extended-profile control and the same eight-case profile acquisition policy. Each variant uses its matching pre-existing word/probe/combined control; fresh profiles bind the changed scorer graph. The panel includes one/seven-byte stored cases to expose short-input fallback losses. Fresh profiles follow the same acquisition policy. No full-score or new qualified peer-win claim.

Full 81-case point screen for the paired packed scorer. Promotion requires all 81 Roc wins and every original named C win plus natural4K in both 96-block confidence-qualified orders. This 24-block screen alone establishes no new qualified score.
